boids_neighbour_lens.name: Boids: who enters the radius?
boids_neighbour_lens.description: The original FlockingControls simulation in a clear bay. The carried point adjusts perception radius. Pause, compare the selected neighbours, and read the three requests for the gold body.
boids_neighbour_lens.qfep_connection: A change in who can count as a neighbour changes the requests, even when the weights and positions stay the same. The visible radius declares the inclusion rule.
